signal: Renewal within 30 days, not active for 7+ days
strategy: Remind them what they came for and what's coming up before renewal; one easy question
example_subject: Before your renewal: what you said you wanted from this
voice_note_idea: Owner: one sentence on what they hoped to get out of the group

signal: Joined 7+ days ago, no intro, no posts
strategy: Lower the bar: invite a one-line intro, or to just listen in on the next call
example_subject: No intro needed. Just come say hi
voice_note_idea: Owner: a personal welcome by name

strategy: Reference their goal or last contribution; ask how it's going, no guilt
voice_note_idea: Owner: asks about their goal in their own words

signal: 5+ posts in total, but no posts and no calls in 30 days
strategy: Notice the change kindly; offer one small way back in
voice_note_idea: Owner: what they appreciated about the member's past posts

signal: A win logged in the last 14 days
strategy: Celebrate it; invite them to share how they did it with the group
example_subject: Saw your win. Would you share how you did it?
voice_note_idea: Owner: congratulations, in their own words

signal: Goal set, not updated for 30+ days
strategy: Check in on the goal itself; offer to reset or shrink it
example_subject: Is the goal still the goal?
voice_note_idea: Owner: permission to change the goal

signal: Active in the last 7 days, but no posts and no calls in 30 days
strategy: Turn reading into one small action: a question to answer, a thread to join
example_subject: A quick question I think you'd answer well
voice_note_idea: Owner: asks them the question directly

signal: Active, but no calls attended in 30 days
strategy: Share what they missed and one reason to join the next one
example_subject: What you missed on Thursday's call
voice_note_idea: Owner: the one takeaway from the last call

strategy: Warm, no-pressure note; ask what would have helped
voice_note_idea: Owner: thanks them for the time they were in
